title: Health, Letters, and Emails
ringkas: Keluhan sakit, memberi saran, dan menulis surat atau email
goals: menyebut bagian tubuh dan keluhan sakit: [[headache]], [[fever]], [[cough]], [[stomachache]]
menanyakan dan menyampaikan keluhan: [[What's the matter?]] dan [[I have a ...]]
memberi semangat: [[Get well soon!]] dan [[Take care!]]
menulis **surat atau email** pendek kepada teman: pembuka, isi, dan penutup

lesson.text: Kamu atau temanmu pernah sakit, bukan? Di **Unit 9** (unit terakhir Kelas 8) kamu belajar **menyebut keluhan sakit**, **memberi saran**, dan **menulis surat atau email** kepada teman, misalnya untuk menanyakan kabar saat ia sakit.

lesson.title: 3. Menanyakan dan menyampaikan keluhan
table: Ada apa? / Ada masalah apa? / Kamu baik-baik saja?
Aku sakit kepala. / Aku merasa tidak enak badan.

lesson.title: Have a ... atau My ... hurts
lesson.text: Dua cara menyebut keluhan: **have a + keluhan** ([[I have a toothache.]]) atau **my + bagian tubuh + hurts** ([[My tooth hurts.]]). Artinya sama.

lesson.title: 4. Memberi saran kesehatan
lesson.text: Pakai **should / shouldn't** (Unit 8) untuk saran, atau **Why don't you ...?**
table: [[Why don't you go to bed early?]]

lesson.title: 6. Menulis surat atau email pendek
lesson.text: Surat pribadi (personal letter) dan email kepada teman punya bagian yang mirip:
table: I heard that you are sick. I hope you feel better.
You should take a rest and drink warm water. We are waiting for you at school.
Take care! / Best wishes, / Your friend,

lines.en: I heard that you are sick. I hope you feel better soon. You should take a rest and drink a lot of water.
lines.id: Aku dengar kamu sakit. Semoga kamu lekas membaik. Sebaiknya kamu istirahat dan minum banyak air.

lines.en: Our class is waiting for you. We will send you the homework tomorrow.
lines.id: Kelas kita menunggumu. Kami akan mengirimkan PR besok.

lesson.title: Surat resmi atau tidak resmi?
lesson.text: Untuk teman, pakai **Dear (nama)** dan penutup santai seperti **Take care** atau **Your friend**. Untuk orang yang lebih tua atau guru, boleh pakai **Dear Mr./Mrs./Miss (nama)** dan penutup **Best regards**.

items: Keluhan: [[I have a headache.]] atau [[My head hurts.]]
Surat/email: **Subject → Greeting → Opening → Body → Closing → Name**.

Dokter: Selamat pagi. Ada keluhan apa?
Budi: Saya demam tinggi dan sakit tenggorokan sejak kemarin. Saya juga batuk.
Dokter: Biar saya periksa. Anda terkena flu. Minum obat ini tiga kali sehari setelah makan. Minum banyak air dan beristirahatlah. Kembali lagi jika tidak membaik dalam tiga hari.

Doctor: Good morning. What's the matter?
Budi: I have a high fever and a sore throat since yesterday. I also have a cough.
Doctor: Let me check. You have the flu. Take this medicine three times a day after meals. Drink a lot of water and get some rest. Come back if you don't feel better in three days.

Kemarin, Budi merasa sakit. Dia sakit kepala dan demam tinggi, jadi dia tidak pergi ke sekolah. Ibunya membawanya ke dokter pada sore hari.
Dokter memeriksa tenggorokannya dan berkata, "Kamu terkena flu. Minum obat ini tiga kali sehari, dan minum banyak air. Kamu sebaiknya beristirahat selama dua hari." Budi mengikuti saran dokter. Sekarang dia merasa jauh lebih baik.

read.text:
Yesterday, Budi felt sick. He had a headache and a high fever, so he did not go to school. His mother took him to the doctor in the afternoon.
The doctor checked his throat and said, "You have the flu. Take this medicine three times a day, and drink a lot of water. You should rest for two days." Budi followed the doctor's advice. Now he feels much better.

Dokter: Selamat pagi, Rani. Sudah berapa lama kamu batuk? Rani: Sudah lima hari, sejak Senin lalu. Aku juga sakit tenggorokan sejak kemarin. Dokter: Apakah kamu sudah minum obat?
Rani: Ya, aku sudah minum sirup, tetapi tidak banyak membantu. Dokter: Apakah kamu demam? Rani: Tidak. Dokter: Bagus. Minum air hangat, dan istirahat. Jika kamu belum pulih pada hari Jumat, kembalilah.

qs.exp: Rani: "I've had it for five days".
qs.q: How long has Rani had the cough?

options: I have a sore throat since yesterday.
I have had a sore throat since yesterday.
I've had it for five days.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Doctor: "If you haven't recovered by Friday, come back."
qs.q: When should Rani come back if she hasn't recovered?
Pasangkan penunjuk waktu dengan artinya:
I've had a cough ___ five days.
I've had a sore throat ___ yesterday.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Apakah kamu sudah minum obat?"

read.text:
Doctor: Good morning, Rani. How long have you had this cough? Rani: I've had it for five days, since last Monday. I've also had a sore throat since yesterday. Doctor: Have you taken any medicine?
Rani: Yes, I've taken some syrup, but it hasn't helped much. Doctor: Have you had a fever? Rani: No, I haven't. Doctor: Good. Drink warm water, and rest. If you haven't recovered by Friday, come back.
read.title: How Long Have You Been Sick?

read.focus: Preposisi kesehatan: for, in, at, on, with, from
read.id:
Dokter: Ada keluhan apa, Budi? Budi: Saya sakit kepala selama tiga hari, dan saya berbaring di tempat tidur sejak Senin. Tenggorokan saya juga sakit. Dokter: Apakah kamu demam? Budi: Ya. Suhunya 38 derajat pada hari Selasa.
Dokter: Sebaiknya kamu tinggal di rumah beberapa hari dan minum banyak air. Minum obat ini bersama makanan, tiga kali sehari. Budi: Apakah saya harus ke sekolah? Dokter: Tidak, belum sampai Jumat. Jika kamu pulih dari flu, kamu bisa kembali hari Senin.

qs.exp: Budi: "I've had a headache for three days".
qs.q: How long has Budi had a headache?

options: I've been on bed since Monday.
I've been in bed since Monday.
You can go back on Monday.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "If you recover ___ the flu, you can go back on Monday."
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
I've had a headache ___ three days.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan at, on, atau in:
qs.q: You can go back ___ Monday.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Minum obat ini bersama makanan."

read.text:
Doctor: What's the matter, Budi? Budi: I've had a headache for three days, and I've been in bed since Monday. My throat hurts, too. Doctor: Do you have a fever? Budi: Yes, I do. The temperature was 38 degrees on Tuesday.
Doctor: You should stay at home for a few days and drink plenty of water. Take this medicine with food, three times a day. Budi: Should I go to school? Doctor: No, not until Friday. If you recover from the flu, you can go back on Monday.
read.title: At the Doctor's
